purpose: Semantic authority for what may be concluded from available C/W/P/A/J/M products. Source presence alone never grants an assessment conclusion.

worlds.W: Approved fact/reference world under declared authority.
worlds.P: Observer-specific information objectively available to the observer.
worlds.J: Approved external adjudication; absence forbids invention of official result.
worlds.M: Machine/platform state and capability evidence, distinct from long-term capability estimates.

allows: approved range/simulator adjudication and action-to-result linkage

context_capability_rule: If versioned C needed for correctness/qualification is missing, normative conclusions degrade to DESCRIPTIVE even if W/P/A/J/M are present.
missing_rules: Missing P: W may not substitute for what a crew actually could observe.
Missing J: action/process may be assessed but official result is N_A/NOT_ADJUDICATED.
Missing M: human/task subsets may remain possible, but platform capability observation/claim is not allowed.
Missing mandatory World product: dependent metric/assessment is N_A or INSUFFICIENT_DATA with reason.
quality_rule: coverage/confidence/quality are evidence-quality descriptors and are not automatically probabilities of correctness or statistical uncertainty intervals.
